green_summary.ProjectWikiInfra.v1: tools/infra/llmwiki.mjs validate|qualify|probe. Exit contract 0=PASS 1=input/prerequisite 2=verification failure (house I01/I02/I03 pattern: registry+refs loads fail-closed, displayPath/redactHostPaths on every structured field, host paths never echoed, no skip:true anywhere). validate checks all four domain files: package lock shape + 40-hex commit + upGate closed, ProjectRoot policy binding and denial declarations, index policy semantics (tiers, index non-authoritative/non-overriding, KnowledgeWrite gates required), MCP component-profile-only scope (host registration claims rejected), secret-ref catalog gaps; returns interfaces summary + violations + catalogGaps. qualify builds the evidence ladder from REAL observations — launcher present/executable + sha256 vs lock, requirements.lock digest recompute via SDD_HOME, local clone HEAD vs lock commit, venv python --version, mcp package version vs lock, canonical workspace identity — and keeps mcp-host-discovery / mcp-write-channel / index-consistency / secret-provisioned honestly UNVERIFIED.
green_summary.ProjectRoot.v1: projectID/repoID/wikiRoot/worktree mapping: git rev-parse --git-common-dir -> main working tree -> <main-tree>/llmwiki; every linked worktree must resolve to that one canonical root (verified for all 14 worktrees of this repo). Containment denials (.. traversal, symlink realpath escape, foreign per-worktree wiki root, project-id mismatch) are enforced unconditionally by the resolver — probe proves hardInvariantsHeld with every declarative flag disabled; validate rejects any policy fixture that declares a denial as false. Structured receipts carry stable labels (<main-working-tree>/llmwiki) and booleans only, never host paths.
green_summary.KnowledgeWrite.v1: only tier=curated entries with approvedBy + source + revision (and factAuthority=approved-curated-entry) are admissible; forbidden authorities (openspec-specs/openspec-tasks/task-checkmarks/source-code/comet-state) and unapproved full-git intake are denied; every write requires independent file readback AND independent index readback — file existence alone reads INCONSISTENT and blocks. Policy keeps project knowledge strictly separated from OpenSpec specs/tasks checkmarks and Comet state.
green_summary.index-policy: raw/staging/curated tri-state with only curated authoritative; index is rebuildable cache — never knowledge authority, never overrides source records; curated source artifacts/versions are the backup unit; R10 unfinished-run staging + approved payloads must survive index rebuild and worktree recycling (declared in index-policy.json:retention).
